assessments.name: Assignment 1
assessments.description:
2 options:
OPTION 1: Creative response analysing the use of the functions of music in social media, by a non-musician.

OR

OPTION 2: Creating musical media for the purposes of participating in an online music Community of Practice.

assessments.name: Early feedback task
assessments.description: Quiz on the UoS outline and Week 3 lecture

assessments.name: Assignment 2: Musicians, Social Media and their Fans
assessments.description: Case study (as a short video or stylised text) comparing how a musician has used social media at two different points in their career, from the perspective of a fan with a parasocial relationship.

assessments.name: Participation in tutorials
assessments.description: Active participation in tutorials and discussion boards. Failure to participate = fail the unit.
